title: Closed-PR semantic salvage and porting convergence plan
mission: Convert the remaining high-value closed-unmerged historical pull requests into bounded semantic-salvage sprints on current main, preserving unique behavior while refusing wholesale replay of stale shared governance, skills, registries, workflows, or launch logic. The program exists to leave AgentSwitchboard clean and portable without requiring successor agents to reconstruct the September 22 forensic analysis from chat.
safeParallelWork: Panels 01-04 are integrated. Panel 06 / PR #79 is dependency-ready on the post-#64 machine-profile floor.
Panel 05 / PR #92 remains ownership-blocked until ASQ-022 becomes terminal or durably hands off disjoint execution-adapter paths; its PR #118 dependency is satisfied.
Final convergence is single-writer after Panels 05 and 06 reach supported terminal dispositions.
forbiddenScope: Direct mutation of historical source branches or their pull requests from this coordination sprint
Bulk merge, bulk cherry-pick, force-reset, force-push, destructive cleanup, or deletion of historical source branches
Implementation changes under tooling/, scripts/, tests/, .ai/skills/, shared registries, workflows, launchers, or product/runtime code
Inventing prompt-parallel-dispatch contracts, scripts, runtime tools, or agent execution proof that current main does not contain
Secrets, credentials, private machine paths, customer data, provider tokens, or raw local runtime evidence
Claiming runtime, Windows workstation, provider, deployment, or user-acceptance proof from this plan
expectedArtifacts: Refreshed schema-valid TRIAGE-01 machine-readable plan with current main and exact historical branch identities
Human-readable launch order, dependency graph, collision ledger, factoring ledger, proof ceilings, and successor phases
Self-contained portability sprint panels for PR #113, #112, #118, #64, #92, #79, and final convergence
Repository work-ledger ASQ-023 index pointing to this canonical plan and first executable continuation
